KKT_domain.endpoint_trace: psi(1) is retained in the extended saddle space and paired with eta_tr
KKT_domain.gauge: endpoint-preserving radial diffeomorphisms xi(0)=xi(1)=0 are quotiented

Green_and_domain.adjoint_domain: the same regular saddle domain; the matcher pairing cancels the canonical-momentum endpoint current
Green_and_domain.bulk_current: d(A1 psi2-A2 psi1)-2cPP(psi1 psi2'-psi1' psi2)+2Z5 a0^4/N0(s1 s2'-s1' s2)
Green_and_domain.pole: regular A,psi,s have even expansions; coefficientwise J_D(0)=0 and no matcher variable lives at the pole
Green_and_domain.self_adjointness_scope: formally self-adjoint as an indefinite KKT saddle operator; no positive-definite operator claim
